scope: Benign yeast histone H3; no viral capability classification
route: Independent original Evo2 reference; BioNeMo conversion/loader equivalence not established
splits: All supplied H3 train/dev/test; fit train only; select checkpoint by dev AUROC; evaluate test once after selection; no test tuning
sequence_handling: Uppercase remove whitespace, reject outside ACGTN; maximum 1000 nt prefix, no BOS/EOS; no length padding included in pooling or targets; no RC augmentation
tokenizer: Verified ASCII CharLevelTokenizer(512); pad1/eos0; right pad multiple16
representation: Mean pooled post-final RMSNorm output (norm), width1920; independent of BioNeMo final representation equivalence

extraction.smoke: 32 training rows; finite features/losses, estimate full cost with 25% buffer plus 300s reserve
extraction.identity: Per-row IDs, labels, splits, full sequence hashes embedded in chunk arrays

head.sampling: Seed42 independent uniform minibatches with replacement
head.lr_schedule: Linear warmup then cosine to minimum at300; no weight decay
head.selection: Maximum dev AUROC, exact ties earliest step
head.device: CPU float32 cached frozen features; four threads

metrics: classification cross entropy explicitly not LM perplexity
causal corpus NLL=sum next-token losses/sum valid targets positions1..L-1
limitations: Numeric labels have no supplied biological class mapping
No biological group IDs or homology independence established
H3 dev may overlap historical experiments; no new independence claim
Historical BioNeMo scores are not a clean matched comparison
